name: gui_rt_two_rays_two_misses
description: RTL-2s b: a ray tracing task of a project with a ray group layout, built from the Graph's ray tracing fields. The fixture (test/fixtures/studio_gui_rt_two_rays_two_misses) has a cube above a floor and a layout of two ray types (primary, shadow), one triangles group (mesh) and two misses (sky, shadow); its task `trace` traces primary only, with shaders/start.* in every place. Picked, the task shows the layout's section instead of the generic ray_tracing row: raygen, a check per ray type, a row per miss, the hit shaders' grid. The shadow ray type checked is one edit that takes primary's cells for its row; New... in the shadow x mesh cell writes a closest hit of the layout's form for that place (payload 1, occluded) and puts it there; New... on the shadow miss writes its miss (not occluded); New... on raygen writes a raygen that names both ray types and both misses by the layout's generated header. The section's Trace shadow toward the light (RTL-2s-c) sets the raygen's TRACE_SECOND_RAY_TYPE to 1, which makes the floor beside the cube darker than the floor on the other side: the shadow of the second ray type. Typed: nothing, in Studio or in a shader file.
